news.title: Adani Green Energy shares fall 4% after Q2 results. What are Jefferies, JM Financial saying?
news.summary: Adani Green Energy reported a 15% year-on-year rise in Q2FY27 net profit to Rs 673 crore, while revenue grew 39% to Rs 4,520 crore. Shares fell 4% after the results. Jefferies maintained its Buy rating, while JM Financial retained Add, citing growth opportunities and operational challenges.

news.title: Lam Research Stock: Why did LRCX shares fall despite record profits?
news.summary: Lam Research posted record revenue of $8.22 billion, driven by AI infrastructure and memory chip demand. Supply constraints, declining China revenue contribution and cautious outlook weighed on investor sentiment despite strong earnings.

news.title: IGI shares hit 10% upper circuit as Q2 profit jumps 43%, revenue rises 31% YoY
news.summary: International Gemological Institute shares hit the 10% upper circuit after Q2 FY27 revenue rose 31% and profit surged 43% year on year. Growth was supported by lab-grown diamonds, stronger margins and rising demand across jewellery and coloured gemstones.

news.title: Global Market: Bank of Korea holds interest rates at 3% after back-to-back hikes
news.summary: The Bank of Korea kept its benchmark interest rate unchanged at 3.00% on Thursday, pausing after back-to-back 25-basis-point hikes in July and August. The decision was in line with expectations of all 34 economists surveyed by Reuters.

news.title: Global Market: Nokia Q3 profit beats estimates on AI demand, maintains 2026 outlook
news.summary: Nokia reported stronger-than-expected third-quarter operating profit and revenue growth, driven by rising demand from AI and cloud customers. Order intake from these segments surged 118% year-on-year, while the company maintained its full-year financial outlook.

news.title: Global Market: Hong Kong stocks slump to four-month low as China stimulus hopes fade
news.summary: Hong Kong stocks plunged to a four-month low, while mainland Chinese blue-chip shares approached bear-market territory as technology stocks sold off. Weak stimulus expectations, concerns over economic imbalances and broader AI-related market losses weighed on investor sentiment.

news.title: Hero Motors shares hit 5% lower circuit; stock still up 42% from IPO price | Check key support level
news.summary: Hero Motors shares fell 5% to a lower circuit on Thursday but remained about 42% above their ₹84 IPO price. The stock is nearing a key ₹112 support level, with a break below it potentially triggering further declines.
